    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    m = int(input[1])
    h = int(input[2])
    u = list(map(int, input[3:3+n]))
    clients = [(int(input[3+n+2*i]), int(input[3+n+2*i+1])) for i in range(m)]

    conflicts = [set() for _ in range(h)]
    for ci1, ci2 in clients:
        conflicts[u[ci1-1]].add(ci1)
        conflicts[u[ci2-1]].add(ci2)

    shifts = set()
    for hour in range(h):
        if len(conflicts[hour]) > len(conflicts[(hour+1)%h]):
            shifts.update(conflicts[hour])

    print(len(shifts))
    print(*shifts)
